candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of sports, athletics, and ball games.
These tokens represent determiners, adjectives, and pronouns indicating quantity, variety, or indefiniteness (such as "some", "other", "several", and "different") primarily in French.
This vector represents Major League Baseball team names and related sports franchises.
This feature vector represents multi-digit numerical values or numeric identification codes.
This feature vector represents terms, prefixes, and abbreviations related to professionals, professions, and professional fields.
This vector activates strongly for proper nouns and capitalized entities, particularly major cities, famous names, and cultural proper nouns.
French demonstrative determiners and related morphological variants.
This vector represents prefixes and modifiers indicating quantity, scale, or relational status.
These tokens represent common French adverbial modifiers and conjunctive adverbs indicating time, frequency, emphasis, or logical connection.
This vector represents words or word fragments containing the phonetic string "-amp-" or related variations centered around victory and distinction.
